scope.sensitivity: sanitized engineering evidence; no credentials or tenant content
scope.permitted_use: review candidate for worker routing, Windows execution, recovery and verification decisions

owner_decision.directive: Add the authorized Windows RDP as an Operations Room execution worker rather than relying only on model/provider workers.
owner_decision.authority_boundary: RDP is execution capacity only; it is not merge, deploy, spend, approval, credential, scheduler, or canonical Memory authority.

provenance.supabase_control_readback: mcpmaster-supabase-control ACTIVE version 79 from governed main
provenance.credential_boundary: Raw RDP worker token remains machine-local; Supabase Vault stores only its SHA-256 verifier.

failures_and_corrections.failure: The first canary entered RDP_EXECUTION_FAILED even though the Java runtime was installed and healthy.
failures_and_corrections.verified_root_cause: On Windows PowerShell 5.1 with ErrorActionPreference=Stop, java -version writes successful version text to stderr and the capture pipeline surfaced it as a RemoteException although the native exit code was zero.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Command-Text temporarily uses ErrorActionPreference=Continue, captures stdout/stderr, treats LASTEXITCODE as execution truth, and restores the prior preference.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: For Windows native-command workers, do not equate stderr output with failure; gate on the native exit code and preserve stderr as evidence.

failures_and_corrections.observed_problem: V2 selected github_runner_verify and produced a valid runner-only handoff while its acceptance text also required toolchain probes.
failures_and_corrections.correction: Do not stretch narrow evidence to satisfy broader acceptance. Cancel the over-broad task and split acceptance into separate toolchain and runner canaries.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: OPS-RDP-TOOLCHAIN-CANARY-V1 and OPS-RDP-RUNNER-CANARY-V1 independently completed and were independently verified.
failures_and_corrections.durable_rule: Execution profile, evidence and acceptance criteria must align exactly; split canaries when one profile cannot truthfully prove every criterion.

failures_and_corrections.behavior: V1 failure entered reconciliation and retained its lease. The scheduled worker was stopped, its heartbeat aged beyond the 60-second freshness fence, provider outcome was established, and recovery released the lease as failed_verified.
failures_and_corrections.outcome: No blind retry and no stranded RDP lease.

review_requirements: Verify Box PRs 774, 775 and 778 and the exact merge/source SHAs.
Verify Operations task statuses and verification receipts for the toolchain and runner canaries.
Confirm the RDP remains a bounded worker and does not gain release or credential authority.
Approve or reject through the existing Memory review path; this candidate is not self-promoted to canonical Memory.
